== Editing ==
English Decipher-era comparison for [[Sniper]]. One column per published text state, in date order: the printed card, Decipher's errata, and each Players Committee image. The stamp row describes the mark on each image. Yellow highlights mark words changed against the column before. Use explicit <code>1=</code> for <code><nowiki>{{Errata hl}}</nowiki></code> arguments.

Reflections Gold: [[Sniper (Reflections Gold)]] is an unpublished playtest text of the cancelled [[Reflections Gold]] set (Decipher, 2001); it has its own column, labelled as such. Its highlights mark words that differ from the published column before it. The next published column is still compared with that published column, not with the playtest.
